accessDenied: Signing key management requires administrator access.
title: Signing Keys
description: GPG and RSA keys used to sign Debian, RPM, Alpine, and Conda artifacts.
noPermission: You don't have permission to manage signing keys
noPermissionHint: Signing-key management is restricted to administrators.
noKeysHint: Create one to start signing artifacts.
createDescription: Generate a key pair. The private key never leaves the server.
viewDescription: Distribute this to verify signed artifacts.
rotateDescription: A new key replaces "{name}". Artifacts already signed stay valid; new signatures use the new key.
revokeDescription: "{name}" will be marked revoked and can no longer sign artifacts.
deleteDescription: "{name}" will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
